explicit_note: This contract defines safe installation requirements for missing model prerequisites. No download, installation, generation, or downstream actions are performed by this contract layer.

safe_install_contract.operator_responsibility: Operator must download assets manually or through an approved, trusted method.
safe_install_contract.placement_rule: Assets must be placed exactly at the expected_install_path specified above. No subdirectories, no renamed files, no symlinks unless verified.
safe_install_contract.file_existence_rule: After placement, a file existence check must pass (os.path.exists or equivalent must return true).
safe_install_contract.extension_validation_rule: File extension must match expected type: .safetensors for checkpoint, .bin for IP-Adapter model.
safe_install_contract.checksum_or_size_rule: Checksum (SHA-256 or MD5) from the trusted source must be recorded. If checksum is unavailable, minimum file size must be recorded and verified (dynavision_v10.safetensors: ~2.0-7.0 GB; ip-adapter-faceid-plus_sd15.bin: ~500-800 MB).
safe_install_contract.partial_download_prohibition: Partial or incomplete downloads are not acceptable. File must be fully written and closed before verification.
safe_install_contract.retry_gate_rule: retry_gate_open must remain FALSE after install until the verification layer passes.
safe_install_contract.generation_prohibition: NO generation is allowed in this layer. The contract explicitly prohibits ComfyUI execution, frame generation, retry_generate_frames, QA rerun, assemble_scene, audio attach, episode render, or any downstream action until controlled_retry_authorization_required is reached.

trusted_source_guidance.dynavision_v10.safetensors: CivitAI (https://civitai.com/search/models?query=dynavision) or HuggingFace. Verify uploader reputation and model page.
trusted_source_guidance.ip-adapter-faceid-plus_sd15.bin: HuggingFace h94/IP-Adapter-FaceID repository. Prefer official release files.

post_install_verification_requirements.description: Future verification step to be executed after manual operator install completes.

required_checks.description: Check both files exist at expected_install_path
Record file size and, if available, SHA-256 checksum
required_checks.pass_criteria: Size within expected range; checksum matches source if source checksum was provided

required_checks.description: Verify file extension matches expected type
Verify retry implementation plan still targets shot01
Verify no generation was performed during install layer

state_transition_after_verification_pass.condition: All post-install verification checks pass AND retry_gate_open == false AND production_accepted == false
